label: Empty state
description: A friendly placeholder that explains why an area has no content and what to do next, such as "No child tickets yet — split large work into child tickets". Collections use the same component automatically when they have no rows; place it explicitly with a visibility rule for custom guidance.
usage: Write the title as the situation ("No child tickets") and the text as the next step.
Set actionLabel only when the viewer can act right there.
Do not use it for errors; use feedback.inline_error.
constraints: title is required (at most 80 characters); text at most 200; actionLabel at most 40.
actionLabel fires the action event, which opens the nearest action.quick_create in the same column or tab; the button is omitted when there is none or the viewer may not create.

accessibility.keyboard: The action button takes Tab and Enter.
accessibility.notes: Announced politely when it replaces content (e.g. after the last row is removed). Illustration is decorative.

responsive: Centered in its container; illustration is hidden below 360px.

props.title: No child tickets
props.text: Split large work into child tickets so each team can track its part.
